triples.tail_surface: Fill open and semi-open bearings with grease before assembly with bearing cover
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 装配轴承盖前给开式及半开式轴承加注润滑脂
triples.evidence_text:
Note: Fill open and semi-open bearings with grease before assembly with bearing cover (ref.
          Section 8).

triples.tail_surface:
Place the support disc (14) (grease valve ring in
ø330/415/418/525 with angular ball bearings) in
the bearing cover and press the bearing into
place in the bearing cover. Lead the shaft (17)
through the bearing cover, support disc and
bearing, and press the bearing into place up
against the support disc.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将支撑盘装入轴承盖并将轴承压入就位，穿轴后再次压紧轴承
triples.evidence_text:
1. Place the support disc (14) (grease valve ring in
ø330/415/418/525 with angular ball bearings) in
the bearing cover and press the bearing into
place in the bearing cover. Lead the shaft (17)
through the bearing cover, support disc and
bearing, and press the bearing into place up
against the support disc.

triples.tail_surface:
If shim(s) are mounted between Pos. 26 and
bearing then also mount shim(s) when bearings
are replaced.
